content: Offline-first is an established market expectation: YNAB markets 'even offline' multi-device access; Bluecoins is local-first with optional cloud sync (Drive/Dropbox/OneDrive) and local backup; Money Manager is local-first with optional sync; Spendee syncs across devices. The project's offline-first Firestore approach matches the category's local-first heritage and is a defensible differentiator, not a niche feature.
